correctedState: Confirmed, with three additions that make the gap wider than stated. (1) Line drift in the evidence: the default is storage.ts:194 (not :189), the load-time trim storage.ts:273-276, the runtime pi-agent.ts:6313-6344 (not :6291-:6320). (2) The single hop fires only for the six codes in FALLBACK_MODEL_RETRY_ERROR_CODES (pi-agent.ts:337-343: invalid_model, model_no_tool_support, network_error, service_error, service_unavailable, provider_error) and is Pi-only -- claude-agent.ts never passes a fallback model to the Claude Agent SDK, so a Claude-backed session has no fallback at all. There is no dedup, no three-entry cap, no ordered chain, no "default" expansion, no availableModels filtering and no compaction context-window rule. (3) In a packaged build the one hop is itself inert: the shipped apps/electron/resources/config-defaults.json:28 has `"fallbackModel": ""`, syncConfigDefaults (storage.ts:200-227) overwrites ~/.nessy-agent/config-defaults.json from that bundled asset on every launch, and no UI, IPC or CLI surface writes the key -- so a user edit does not survive a restart. The sentence's second clause diverges too: apps/cli has no `--fallback-model` flag, interactive or otherwise.
